details.description: Seed rate: 1.2kgs/acre, Number of plants per acre: 1,600, Spacing: 100cm x 250cm, Number of days in nursery bed: (0)-direct sowing, Maturity days after transplanting: 80-85 days. Suitable for harvesting either immature green or fully mature red brown depending on market demands, good shelf life. Flesh is yellow in colour, firm, sticky and has excellent taste.
